reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Michelle Jarecki
reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience with Meier & Sons Tree Service from start to finish. Our neighbor referred us, and we’re so glad they did! Logan came out promptly to discuss a plan for removing several trees and stumps and even provided a quote the same day, which we really appreciated. He was easy to communicate with, professional, and got us scheduled quickly. Throughout the process, he was flexible and accommodating, he even added on a few small extra tasks without any hassle. Whenever any questions or minor issues came up, he handled them right away and made sure everything was taken care of. The whole experience was smooth, efficient, and stress-free. We highly recommend this company and would absolutely use them again!

reviews.author: Patrick Soderlund
reviews.text: Logan’s and his crew did an amazing job removing two dead cedar trees leaning towards our house. Not only were they very professional but even worked through a rain down pour to finish the job. We can’t speak highly enough about Meier and Sons Tree service. If you need any tree service this is the team to get it done!

reviews.author: MK Burns
reviews.text: I am so thankful for Meier & son’s tree service! Not only did they make time on Memorial Day to remove a very dead and potentially dangerous tree, but it was absolutely POURING rain. Logan and his crew were nothing but professional, timely and genuinely happy to come out and help us. Their prices and response time can’t be beat. 100/10 would recommend!

reviews.author: Bridget Dolan
reviews.text: Hired this company for a large tree I needed removed. Logan was able to come out and remove it within days and was extremely quick and professional. Very reasonable pricing as well. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Danielle Dunlap
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a tree service that shows up on time, works insanely hard and somehow makes cutting down trees look like an Olympic sport… this is your crew. They are FREAKING awesome. Professional, efficient and left our yard looking better than before they started. 10/10 would trust them with any tree (even the dramatic ones). Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Victor Sanchez
reviews.text: Recently reached out to Logan about getting added to his schedule. He was very accommodating and was able to work it during busy times. His crew was very professional and proficient, advising along the way answering any questions I had. Couldn’t be happier with the end result and the time it took start to finish. If you are considering a tree removal, I highly recommend Logan and his team over at Meier & Sons Trees Service.

reviews.author: Richard Huens
reviews.text: I selected this business via the internet. Looked very competent, professional, and safe. Was not sure what the price was going to be. It turned out to be very reasonable. They were extremely safe and took great care of my house, fence and landscaping. Safety was their greatest concern. Logan told me when they are done, you will never know two 60 foot trees were removed. He was right. Everything was cleaned up, raked, and any debris disposed of properly. I can not say enough about the quality of their work. If you want a safe and professional job at a reasonable price, these are your guys. Also, it is a family run small business staffed with military veterans.

reviews.author: r mcvay
reviews.text: They did an excellent job at my office. Took down 11 trees and removed the stumps. The whole area was cleaned up and looked great when they were finished. I highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: Alan 84
reviews.text: The guys did a great job clearing out a tree and some limbs at my home. The tree was taking down with precision and clean up was like they weren’t here. I highly recommend this service! Thanks for your work!

reviews.author: Trevor Dawson
reviews.text: All around exceptional service. Great pricing! Highly recommend Logan and his crew for all your tree needs.

reviews.author: Tobin Blatchford
reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND!! I contacted Meier & Sons to remove five large pine trees that were located in a narrow area between my home and my neighbors. I figured this would be a challenging removal not only because of the proximity of the trees to the homes, but my fence was also directly below the trees. However, it did not appear to be a challenge for them. After providing us with a more than fair quote, Logan and his crew returned only days later and started working diligently to set up a series of complex rope systems to guarantee the trees would come down in the proper location. Logan and his team are highly skilled and incredibly professional. I was extremely impressed watching them meticulously remove these trees and upon completion, Logan and his crew thoroughly cleaned the surrounding area from any brush. I highly recommend using Meier and Sons!

reviews.author: Amber Spring
reviews.text: Highly recommend Logan and his team for any tree service you may need- they took the time to look over our yard and trees, and gave us feedback for what was going to be the best options (such as complete removal or just trimming some branches). We have used them multiple times now and it's always been easy going. Will never use anyone else in the area!

reviews.author: Steve Smith
reviews.text: Logan Meier and his team are the best tree professionals I have ever hired. Great work ethic and high quality job. Logan and the men show up early and work all day. They did both tree removal and pruning. You would never know the tree was there and the pruning work left the tree much more attractive and healthier. These men are top notch! My wife and I were thrilled and highly recommend them to anyone with tree needs in the future.

reviews.author: Madeline Smith
reviews.text: Meier and Sons took care of a large dead tree sitting very close to my house. They are professional, honest, quick, and they do a thorough job! If you are in need of tree removal services, Meier and Sons is it.

reviews.author: Lynsey S
reviews.text: Logan and his team are great to work with! We had mutliple trees that needed to be taken down. Some of the spaces were tight due to existing structures. They did an incredible job. From calling to get an estimate to completion of the job, Logan and his team communicated the process and what to expect. They were prompt and cleaned up the sites afterwards. Meier & Sons Tree Service was very competitive. I paid exactly what was quoted, there weren't any surprises. They were able to complete the work in one day. Logan answered all our questions and verified the exact trees to make sure we were all in agreement with what needed to come down. Can't recommend them enough. We will be using them in the future for our tree service needs.

reviews.author: Dakota
reviews.text: Great guys - Logan came out for a quote on Saturday, was super nice, and gave us recommendations for which trees to remove that were either unhealthy or to get the "look"/space that we wanted. He showed up 7am Monday with his crew, and worked hard all day to get the job done quickly. Super reasonably priced. We also love supporting military families! Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Jill Mudge
reviews.text: USE THESE GUYS! This was the best experience I’ve had with any company since moving to the area. Logan came right out to give me a quote and gave me options to fit within my budget. The communication was fantastic, the team was punctual, and they cleaned up as they went!! I cannot recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Amy South
reviews.text: We are so grateful for all of the Meier team for coming out and cutting limbs and removing trees. It has made such a huge difference in the appearance of our yard, my only regret is not having them come sooner! They were able to fit us in to their schedule quickly, showed up on time, and worked until the job was done. They also listened to our requests for the trees and made it happen better than we pictured. It was impressive watching them quickly scale up a tree to start cutting and they seamlessly cleared the limbs hanging over our roof without a problem. Don’t hesitate to use Meier and Sons for your trees!

reviews.author: Dustin
reviews.text: Guys came out and did a great job, left no noticeable damage to my yard. They cleaned everything up like they weren’t even there.

reviews.author: Elwood Sherman
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable, professional, on time, and thorough. Took down 3 large pines, removed all debris, had stumps ground and exposed roots. Very happy with the professionalism Logan and his crew provided. Will definitely be using them again.

reviews.author: Amanda Wilson
reviews.text: Logan was very fast at coming out for a quote and was able to do the job within a week. The price was the best we got in the area. He was professional, respectful of my concerns and very fast. Would highly recommend for anyone looking to get some trees serviced on their property.

reviews.author: Colt Gass
reviews.text: Logan and his team were very quick to get a tree taken care of for us. They provide great communication, price, and services. We appreciated them squeezing us in to their schedule. Highly recommend their services and will absolutely use them again any time we need to in the future.

reviews.author: Pamela Jacobsen
reviews.text: Meier & Sons was completely professional! Showed up on time and got right to work. Very respectful of my property and did a fabulous job of thinning out the NUMEROUS pine trees in my yard. I am super happy with the results and highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Travis Vickerson
reviews.text: Great value company that delivers quality and results without a headache. Not the cheapest but the best, had them remove 4 trees threatening my house and it’s like there were never there now.

reviews.author: Jacob Caudle
reviews.text: I contacted Meier and Sons on a Monday and the tree I wanted taken down was on the ground and the stump grinded Wednesday morning. Logan came with a fair price and executed his job quickly and professionally. I’ll be contacting them next time I need a tree or stump removed.

reviews.author: Garrett P
reviews.text: Meier's was extremely professional with helping cut down some problem trees around my house. They were able to take down a large tree with a huge bend in it exactly where they predicted and made sure I was happy with their service. I would recommend them to anyone needing tree services

reviews.author: ethan smith
reviews.text: Excellent service! Logan and his crew were extremely skilled and proficient and couldn't have done a better job. Great work at a super affordable price... I will definitely be using them for future projects!

reviews.author: Alana Rauhoff
reviews.text: We had more than 10 trees taken down. They got the job done quickly and cleaned up every single piece of remaining debris. Stump grinding was also included. The owner was very responsive and professional. There’s not another tree service in the area that I would use over Meier and Sons.

reviews.author: Summer Meile
reviews.text: Meier and Sons is the best around, the guys are so great, they work incredible fast, are very professional, and are happy to do hard work the right way. They are great hard working men, I can’t recommend them enough!!!

reviews.author: steven valencia
reviews.text: Great pricing excellent service did an amazing job. Even moved my kids playground out of the way. Logan is a professional in what he does 15/10 would recommend

reviews.author: Marc Eckard
reviews.text: A great company! The tree was close to my house and they took the time to ensure no part of the tree ever touched the house. Ground the stump,cleaned everything up and hauled it all away.

reviews.author: Kimberly Brown
reviews.text: Logan and his team were excellent! They were professional, knowledgeable, and reasonably priced. 10 out of 10 recommend!

reviews.author: Nick France
reviews.text: Removed 2 trees from tight quarters with no injury, or damage. Price was good, service was great, and finished result was exactly what we wanted. Could not have asked for better results.

reviews.author: Lisa Jordan
reviews.text: As a homeowner who expects 5 star service these guys deliver. Prompt, professional and clean! My backyard looks amazing.

reviews.author: Cameron Springer
reviews.text: Awesome guys, incredibly helpful and fair pricing. Will definitely use in the future and would highly recommend to anyone who needs any kind of tree work performed.

reviews.author: Connor Dutton
reviews.text: He did a great job at a fair price would hire again. Nice guy courteous and very happy with his work.

reviews.author: Mac Clark
reviews.text: Half of a split trunk birch leaning over home removed and cleaned up canopy. Quick turnaround, arrived on time, neat work, professionalism from all 3 guys. No damage. A pleasure to work with.

reviews.author: aaron williams
reviews.text: Logan and team came to my house and expertly removed a 60+ ft Longleaf Pine that was dead standing. They fell the tree without damaging any other trees in my heavily wooded back yard. Logan and crew, were professional, polite and expeditious with the task. Would use again and recommend to others.

reviews.author: Andrew B
reviews.text: Can’t recommend them enough. They did a great job on our trees and were friendly, professional, and incredibly hard-working. Prices were fair and the quality of work was excellent.

reviews.author: Charles Barnes
reviews.text: I highly recommend Meier and Sons! Great price and great service. If you want a team that shows up on time and gets the job done, these are your guys. They took down 15 trees for us with ease in some challenging conditions. I couldn't recommend more for anyone in the area looking for tree work.

reviews.author: Kimson
reviews.text: I can’t say enough great things about Logan and this company. He and his team completed two separate projects at my home, and both experiences were outstanding from start to finish. His team showed up on time, communicated clearly, and handled everything with a level of professionalism and respect that sets them apart from companies. The quality of their work was excellent, they approached each job with care, precision, and attention to detail, making sure everything was done safely and exactly as discussed. They also took the time to answer my questions and made me feel confident in the process. What impressed me most was their work ethic and integrity. It’s clear they take pride in what they do, and it shows in the results. My property looks better than ever, and the cleanup afterward was just as thorough as the work itself. I highly recommend Meier & Sons to anyone looking for reliable, skilled, and respectful service. Supporting a veteran-owned business that delivers this level of quality is an easy choice. -Kim
